## Plan

- `hh-ledger` stays custody-agnostic: the algorithm seam extends —
  `ED25519_ALG`, `<alg>:<hex>` canonical signature spellings, declared
  length tables (32 B HMAC-SHA-256 / 64 B Ed25519),
  `AuditSigner::alg_ref`, `AuditKeyResolver::verify_sig`,
  `check_checkpoint_signatures` folding the effective signer set,
  `CheckpointClaim.key_rotation` + `CheckpointExtras.key_rotation` +
  `Store::signer_rotation_checkpoint` (generic `checkpoint` refuses
  `kind = rotation` without the dedicated path), `classes.rs` registers
  the claim field. The HMAC construction is retained verbatim.
- `hh-secrets` owns custody: `LedgerSignerCustody` (provision / open /
  rotate / install) over `<store_root>/secrets/ledger-signer.<key_id>.pkcs8`
  at `0600`, key ids `ed25519-<hex(sha256(pubkey))[..16]>`, content-
  derived file names, `ledger-signer.active` pointer, typed
  `CustodyError` refusals (missing / corrupt / wrong permissions /
  ambiguous+dangling active / filename–key-id mismatch / self-check),
  `Ok(None)` only on the unprovisioned posture, never a fallback;
  `LedgerSignerKey` (the `AuditSigner`), `LedgerSignerResolver`
  (public-only `AuditKeyResolver` holding active+retired ids),
  `CustodySourceResolver` (serves only `operator_vault:ledger-signer`,
  delegates the rest, fail-closed); the `ledger-signer` channel is
  `CredentialKind::SigningKey`, `bindable: false`,
  `AccessClass::KernelOnly`, no destinations, no env projection, no
  canary; `install` rides `kernel_use` so the durable
  `security.credential.used{destination = kernel:ledger_signing}` row
  precedes the returned value.
- `hh-embed` composes: `EmbedService::open` custody-loads (typed
  `Refused` on defect; honest unprovisioned posture preserved),
  `install_signer_custody` provisions + installs the resolver +
  self-checks (sign-on-boot), `signer_key_ids` stamped on every
  kernel-opened `RunManifest` (never caller-declared),
  `emit_final_checkpoint` at `lifecycle.run.finished` (post_drive_scan
  + the `close` path — idempotent), `rotate_ledger_signer` co-signs the
  rotation row and retains the incumbent public key;
  `set_credential_resolver` composes custody ahead of the host resolver
  and re-registers the signer channel.
- Batteries per crate: `tests/r4_15e.rs` ×3.
- Discharges per the contract; ADR-0376 in the ADR-0359 dep-scope
  shape; ADR index regenerated by tooling.

## Evidence report

- Layer: **fixture-verified** — exercised end-to-end against fixtures
  (`live_verification=false`; no staging/public/live claim, no
  production mutation).
- Custody: Ed25519 keypairs generated per installation under
  `<store_root>/secrets/` — PKCS#8 documents named
  `ledger-signer.ed25519-<hex16>.pkcs8` at `0600` with a
  `ledger-signer.active` pointer; boot loads active+retired; every
  defect arm is a typed `CustodyError`, `Ok(None)` only on the empty
  posture.
- Signing path: `EmbedService` opens custody → registers the
  `kernel_only`/`bindable:false` `ledger-signer` channel →
  `kernel_use(LedgerSigning)` (durable `security.credential.used` row
  first) → `LedgerSignerKey` built *from the provisioned value* →
  resolver installed → manifest `signer_key_ids` stamped → boot
  `on_demand` checkpoint self-checks the pair.
- Checkpoint fold: signatures parse as `<alg>:<hex>` under
  `alg_ref ∈ {hmac-sha256, ed25519}`; the effective signer set folds
  through `key_rotation` claims only when incumbent+successor both
  signed — retired ids stay resolvable so historical rows verify;
  malformed/undeclared/unresolvable/mismatched signatures all type out.
- Emission: boot `on_demand` checkpoint; `kind = final` on
  `lifecycle.run.finished` via both the scan and the close paths
  (idempotent); `kind = rotation` via the dedicated co-signed method
  only.
- Discharges: DF-S2.5-1 **DONE** (members (a)+(b); member (c)
  `request_redaction` recorded verbatim as declared
  `staged_experimental`); DF-S1.15-1 **DONE** (full-membership
  re-enumeration, every dated marker cited); R-2.8.6 PARTIAL → **MET**;
  BL-30/BL-05 dated cells; ADR-0345 trigger (b) fired-answered
  (`docs/build/reports/2026-10-22-adr-0345-trigger.md`); ADR-0376.
- Deviation: ~3,507 changed lines vs 900 — recorded + surfaced
  (standing GATE-G6 accounting; the operator's call at review).
